question: Who received the 'Most Impactful Environmentalist' award in 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Acharya Prashant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Acharya Prashant receives ‘Most Impactful Environmentalist’ award on World Environment Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Acharya Prashant**, a **philosopher and author**, received the **‘Most Impactful Environmentalist’** award.

 
 
• 
 
The award was presented by the **Green Society of India** on **World Environment Day** (5 June).

 
 
• 
 
Recognized for **integrating spiritual clarity with environmental awareness**.

 
 
• 
 
Honoured at the **World Environment Conference 2025**, held in **Greater Noida**.

 
 
• 
 
Launched **“Operation 2030”**, a nationwide initiative to **awaken and educate youth** on climate issues.

 
 
• 
 
He is a **Vedanta teacher** and **founder of PrashantAdvait Foundation**.

 
 
• 
 
Authored **160+ books**, focusing on **inner transformation** and **social responsibility**.
